articles.title: AI is moving at lightning speed. Can regulation keep up?
articles.summary: FDA's Jared Seehafer admits they're building 2026 policy for technology that will be obsolete by 2027. HHS scrambling with RFIs while hospitals deploy ambient AI without governance frameworks.
articles.linkedin_angle: While the FDA debates 'adaptive AI policy,' health systems are already making life-and-death decisions with ungoverned algorithms. The question isn't whether AI will be regulated — it's whether you'll have governance infrastructure when that regulation lands.

articles.title: Healthcare Standards Institute Announces ANSI/HSI 2800:2025
articles.summary: First national standard for AI governance in healthcare operations. 'Boards and CEOs don't need to be technologists to lead AI…they need a governance system that makes AI accountability real.'
articles.linkedin_angle: ANSI/HSI 2800:2025 just proved what we've been saying: AI governance isn't a tech problem, it's a leadership problem. Health systems that treat it like infrastructure will win.

articles.title: Key Developments Impacting Medical Practices — Spring 2026
articles.summary: HHS Office of Technology Policy RFI on clinical AI adoption. Epic, Oracle, Abridge submitted proposals. Trump administration signaling lighter-touch AI governance while states advance own laws.
articles.linkedin_angle: Federal deregulation + state patchwork = compliance nightmare. Health systems need governance infrastructure that works across jurisdictions. Playing regulatory whack-a-mole isn't a strategy.

articles.title: How AI Agents and Tech Will Transform Health Care in 2026
articles.summary: BCG forecasts accelerating AI agent adoption boosting care quality and innovation, but missing governance piece entirely. Pure tech perspective with zero risk management consideration.
articles.linkedin_angle: BCG sees AI agents transforming healthcare in 2026. I see AI agents creating liability nightmares without governance frameworks. Innovation without accountability isn't transformation — it's Russian roulette.

articles.title: Council Post: How AI Will Help Solve Healthcare's Biggest Challenges In 2026
articles.summary: Healthcare systems under strain from financial shortfalls, workforce burnout, regulatory complexity. Article focuses on AI as solution but ignores governance as prerequisite.
articles.linkedin_angle: Forbes says AI will solve healthcare's biggest challenges in 2026. But ungoverned AI IS healthcare's biggest challenge in 2026. You can't automate your way out of accountability.

articles.title: FDA finalized rules around AI self-updating capabilities
articles.summary: August 2025 FDA rules now live: AI tools can update themselves post-approval but within strict learning boundaries. Creates massive compliance monitoring requirements.
articles.linkedin_angle: The FDA just made continuous AI governance mandatory. Every self-updating algorithm needs real-time compliance monitoring. Hope your health system's ready for algorithmic auditing at scale.
